title: Week 1: Getting started
text:
Before you start
Download the week 1 student pack and unzip it (instructions below). It contains both of this week’s workbooks and a data folder. Leave them in the extracted folder for now: in session 2 you’ll create a project folder for the module and move them into it.






ImportantUnzip the pack before you open anything



The student pack is a zip file: one compressed file that holds several files and folders. You need to extract (unzip) it before RStudio can use what’s inside.
On Windows

Find the zip file you downloaded. It’s usually in your Downloads folder.
Right-click it and choose Extract All….
Click Extract. A new, ordinary folder appears next to the zip, with the same name but without “.zip” on the end.
Open that new folder. You should see the workbook file(s) and a folder called data.

On a Mac
Double-click the zip file. It unzips automatically into a folder with the same name, next to the zip.
Then, in RStudio, choose File › Open File…, go into the extracted folder, and open the workbook.
Don’t open the workbook from inside the zip. Windows lets you look inside a zip file as if it were a folder, but a workbook opened that way can’t reliably save your answers and can’t find its data. If the folder you’re looking at has a zip (zipper) icon, or “.zip” in its name in the address bar, you’re still inside the zip: go back and use Extract All… first.

title: Week 1: Getting started
text:
Session 1: R and RStudio basics

Before
Work through the session 1 pre-session page. Everything runs in your browser.


During
Open week-01-session-1-workbook.qmd from the extracted folder in RStudio (File › Open File…) and work through the activities, with the Guide to R 01 open alongside. There is also a web version of the workbook if you want to read ahead.

text:
Session 2: Projects, importing data and a first plot

Before
Work through the session 2 pre-session page.


During
Open week-01-session-2-workbook.qmd and start with Activity 1, which sets up the project folder you’ll use for the rest of the module. Keep the Guide to R 02 open alongside. (Web version of the workbook.)


After the week
Make sure both workbooks are saved in your R_module project folder, then click Render on each one and check that the web pages it produces contain all your answers.
